params.caption: 🏆 13-year-old Filipino player knocks out Japanese pro PINYA A 13-year-old Tekken 8 competitor from the Philippines has beaten Japanese pro PINYA at Thaiger Uppercut 2026, a stop on the Tekken World Tour. Upsets of established pros by players this young are rare on the TWT circuit, and the win has the fighting game scene talking about a new name to watch. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 00:03 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 🔥 React if you love a big upset · 💬 Future world champion? #Tekken8 #TekkenWorldTour #ThaigerUppercut #FGC #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
